mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_track_days ( id, trip_id, user_id, local_date, day_number, line_segments, bbox, distance_m, flight_distance_m, moving_seconds, elevation_gain_m, elevation_loss_m, point_count, province_codes, first_at, last_at, created_at, updated_at, data_version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tripId}, #{userId}, #{localDate}, #{dayNumber}, #{lineSegments}::jsonb, #{bbox}::jsonb, #{distanceM}, #{flightDistanceM}, #{movingSeconds}, #{elevationGainM}, #{elevationLossM}, #{pointCount}, COALESCE(#{provinceCodes}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), #{firstAt}, #{lastAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 1 ) ON CONFLICT (trip_id, user_id, local_date) DO UPDATE SET day_number = EXCLUDED.day_number, line_segments = EXCLUDED.line_segments, bbox = EXCLUDED.bbox, distance_m = EXCLUDED.distance_m, flight_distance_m = EXCLUDED.flight_distance_m, moving_seconds = EXCLUDED.moving_seconds, elevation_gain_m = EXCLUDED.elevation_gain_m, elevation_loss_m = EXCLUDED.elevation_loss_m, point_count = EXCLUDED.point_count, province_codes = EXCLUDED.province_codes, first_at = EXCLUDED.first_at, last_at = EXCLUDED.last_at, updated_at = NOW(), data_version = trip_track_days.data_version + 1
